plugin.name: Clarity
plugin.description: Things 3-inspired task clarity layer. Smart views for Inbox, Today, Upcoming, Anytime, Someday with inline task editing.
plugin.author: asktru
plugin.lastUpdateInfo: Hotfixes: date-picker month-navigation arrows now work, calendar day cells render as uniform circles on narrow widths, the inline task editor auto-scrolls into view with breathing room when opened near the viewport edge, and saving a task no longer jumps the note scroll back to the top.

plugin.settings.title: Inbox Lookback Days
plugin.settings.description: How many days back to scan daily notes for inbox tasks. Adjustable per-session from the Inbox view header.

plugin.settings.title: Upcoming Lookahead Days
plugin.settings.description: How many days into the future to scan daily notes for upcoming tasks. Adjustable per-session from the Upcoming view header.

plugin.settings.title: Excluded Folders
plugin.settings.description: Comma-separated folder names to exclude from scanning (in addition to @Archive, @Trash, @Templates).

plugin.commands.name: Show in Clarity
plugin.commands.description: Open the current note in the Clarity view
